summary: AURA Chat Enhancement iteration 36 - All 12 backend tests passed (100%), all UI tests passed. Tested: 1) Dynamic product knowledge injection, 2) Page-aware contextual responses, 3) Quick action chips (4 buttons), 4) Clickable internal links with gold styling, 5) Lead capture form after 3+ messages with skip option, 6) Text input via Enter key, 7) Session context maintenance. AURA correctly hides on mobile (desktop-only by design).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 36 focused on AURA chat enhancements. All features working: dynamic product knowledge from MongoDB (57 products), page-aware context (28 page mappings in PAGE_CONTEXT_MAP), 4 quick action chips, clickable internal links (gold #E5C574), lead capture after 3 messages. AURA is desktop-only by design. The chat uses GPT-5.2 via emergentintegrations library with ~5-12 second response time. Key files: /app/frontend/src/components/AuraChat.js, /app/backend/routes/chat.py. Preview URL: https://deepspace-preview.preview.emergentagent.com
